install_steps: sudo apt install yank  # Debian/Ubuntu; or: brew install yank
note: Needs a clipboard backend: xsel (default), xclip, wl-copy, or pbcopy - pick one with 'yank -- wl-copy' on Wayland. Use 'yank -1' to skip the selection UI when only one field matches (script-friendly). Source build: git clone https://github.com/mptre/yank && make install.
